card.name: Vial and single-use wording
card.fires_on: The end of 'vial' (the 'ial' piece) or the 'time' in 'one-time' when describing a single container of injectable drug. Also seen on an exponent digit before 'cells per kg'.

modes.label: Vial
modes.description: The 'ial' ending of 'vial' in preparation or contents statements.

modes.label: One-time use
modes.description: The 'time' in 'one-time use only' after 'Each vial/syringe is for'.
modes.example: Each vial is for one<<-time>> use only. Discard any unused portion

card.writes: It suppresses 'per' and Chinese 'per each' words, so it steers away from a 'per unit' phrase after the container word.
card.plain: It marks the point in injection instructions where a vial or single-use container has just been named.
